name: cnsplots-v3
summary: Publication-ready scientific visualization in Python across major journals (Cell default, Nature, Science). Features an actionable 6-step closed-loop workflow (environment -> data profiling & plot mapping -> layout architecture & budgeting -> ~100px build with zero overrides -> statistical truth extraction & cleanup -> output verification), dual execution modes (cnsplots native or zero-dependency pure matplotlib/seaborn via standalone cns_cell.mplstyle), and a dedicated references/plot-catalog.md.

changes: Restructured SKILL.md into a deterministic, data-driven 6-step closed-loop workflow (SOP).
Decoupled the 30+ plot function catalog into a standalone references/plot-catalog.md.
Exported standalone styles/cns_cell.mplstyle for zero-dependency fallback via pure matplotlib/seaborn.
Added proactive environment branching: prompt user to choose between installing cnsplots or using pure mplstyle.
Enforced ~100 px/pt (80, 100, 120, 150) panel sizing baseline and strict prohibition of font/marker manual overrides.
Set Cell Press 10-color palette as the default qualitative palette, with support for Nature, Science, and other journal styles.
Set Arial sans-serif typography as the default font hierarchy across templates and workflows.
